aboutText: With over 15 years of hands-on experience, NP Carpentry & Construction has been serving homes across Ardeer and Melbourne's western suburbs. We pride ourselves on honest communication, precise workmanship and finishing every project on time and on budget. Whether it's a small repair or a full home extension, our skilled team treats your property like our own. That's why so many of our clients come back to us again and again.
fullWidthImageAlt: NP Carpentry construction site in Melbourne's western suburbs
servicesText: From custom kitchen fit-outs to complete home extensions, NP Carpentry delivers quality results across every project. We handle everything from small repairs to large-scale renovations, always with attention to detail and fair pricing.
